Manchester United have Brentford and Republic of Ireland centre-back Nathan Collins, 25, high on their list of January targets (TalkSport), external
Japan midfielder Ao Tanaka, 28, is close to signing a new contract with Leeds United until 2029 (Sky Sports News, external)
Leeds forward Dominic Calvert-Lewin, 29, is also in contract extension talks amid interest from Manchester United in the England international. (Mail - subscription required), external
Bournemouth have slapped a £100m price tag on France forward Eli Junior Kroupi amid interest from Arsenal, Barcelona and Paris St-Germain. (TalkSport), external
Liverpool are close to finalising a new deal for 18-year-old England winger Rio Ngumoha. (Teamtalk), external
Roma are keen to sign 26-year-old Englishman Callum Hudson-Odoi on loan from Nottingham Forest in January. (Football Insider), external

Como and Napoli are among the clubs interested in signing Manchester United forward Joshua Zirkzee in January, with both clubs awaiting clarity on the 25-year-old Dutchman's place within Mauricio Pochettino's plans. (Sky Sports), external
Newcastle United and England left-back Lewis Hall, 22, will not be sold in the January transfer window. (iPaper), external

Manchester United and Barcelona have stepped up their interest in Borussia Dortmund winger Mathis Albert, 17, who made his United States debut under United boss Mauricio Pochettino. (Teamtalk, external)

Napoli have met with Scott McTominay's agent in Manchester to continue talks over a contract extension for the Scotland midfielder. The 29-year-old's current deal runs until 2028. (Gianluca Di Marzio), external
